_: White SF Symbol glyphs keyed out of the Figma 3x exports (assets/refs, 3 px/pt) at measured pt boxes: the ink box from probes.json plus a 1pt margin. gen.py solves alpha = (pixel - disc) / (255 - disc) inside each box, writes assets/art/.png and places the back at the same numbers, so a glyph cannot drift from where it was measured.
